value.title: Questo gioco fa schifo!
value.synopsis: The reviews are out, the impressions are in, and the overwhelming response is that this is a junk game. However, the cast refuse to take this lying down and vow to change things up on the second playthrough!

value.title: Questo sistema fa schifo!
value.synopsis: It's a New Game+, and the cast runs into a major issue right off the bat: the King's overly long exposition dump!

value.title: This Maid Is Junk!
value.synopsis: Now with a maid in the party for whatever reason, the cast must make adjustments before they head for the first town on the map.

value.title: This Villain Is Junk!
value.synopsis: The party realize they're dealing with a very whimsical player as they travel to the town of Lynx and visit a weapons shop there.

value.title: This Holy Sister Is Junk!
value.synopsis: Mina's now the holy sister and the main focus in combat, but can she really handle all this responsibility?

value.title: These Heroines Are Junk!
value.synopsis: The OG heroines feel threatened by Mina and resort to drastic measures to further their agenda.

value.title: This Quest Is Junk!
value.synopsis: The party is railroaded into a quest they don't want and one, as they later find out, they don't want to complete.

value.title: This Main Story Quest Is Junk!
value.synopsis: The party arrives in the town of Icily, where the hero's shield rests. Surprise, surprise, they are immediately told to go get it.

value.title: This Cleric Is Junk!
value.synopsis: The party approaches the hero's shield, which needs the talents of a cleric to be unsealed.

value.title: This Seal Is Junk!
value.synopsis: Will Mina be the key to unlocking the shield after two heroines failed?

value.title: This Goddess Is Junk!
value.synopsis: Goddess Elouisa chimes in while the team's having a strategy meeting to sort out the mess they're in.

value.title: I Won't Let You Call Us a Junk Anime!
value.synopsis: Elouisa's setup bears fruit and helps solve most of the party's issues, but is all well that ends well?
